harnessNotes.*: Skill Distill needs Python 3.10+, git, bash, and tmux, plus the student harness CLI on PATH; run scripts/setup/doctor.py first. On Windows, run it inside WSL.
harnessNotes.claude: As the teacher, pass --reference claude to init: it finds the newest Claude Code session of the reference folder in ~/.claude/projects.
harnessNotes.codex: As the teacher, pass --reference codex to init: it finds the newest Codex rollout of the reference folder in ~/.codex/sessions.
